data.content:
Shanahan revealed that Kirk endured multiple setbacks during his recovery from the initial leg injury, delaying his 2026 debut. However, after a strong weekend of conditioning, Thursday marked Kirk’s first official practice session with the team.

## Related stories

"He had a real good week and an awesome weekend," Shanahan said regarding Kirk’s progress. [...] LB Nick Martin: Will not be activated from IR this week despite depth needs at linebacker.

According to Vrabel, starting guards Ben Brown (knee) and Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) are unlikely to play. However, starting RT Morgan Moses (ankle) has a chance to play.
